senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. לחך)to lap, lick. Pesik. Zakh. p. 26ᵇ אומה שבאה לָלוֹק וכ׳ (not שבא); Tanḥ. Ki Thetse 9; Yalk. Deut. 938, v. לָק.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 9:3">Par. IX, 3</cite> <he>מפני שהיא מֵלֶקֶת</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>מְלִקָּה</he>) because it (the weasel) laps (lets the water drip back out of its mouth).
